divergences.what: Forest Temple small keys: the remake has 5 keys and 5 locked doors. Obj_DoorChainLock_A_01 is one lock actor per side of a locked door (10 = 5 doors x 2; every locked Obj_ForestTemple_Door_A_01 links exactly two of them); Obj_DoorChainLock_A_02 is the boss-key lock of the basement's boss shutter Obj_ForestTemple_SwitchShutter_A_04. Three doors are N64's; new locked doors are entrance room -> first hallway and bow room -> Beth's room, while N64's locked doors twisted hallway -> Joelle's room and Beth's room -> NE corridor are now a plain door and a shutter.
